cites.stt: The Problem with America’s Lab Mice [video]
Bodybuilding supplement promotes healthy aging and extends life span in mice
cites.x: This podcast delves into the problem with lab mice and explains the trade offs that happen on an evolutionary and cellular level in mice with regards to longevity. [link]
Long story short, having cells die after a number of replications is a postive trade off. It means that when a cell replicates too fast it also dies fast.
